title: "What is iBridges‑GUI"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

[iBridges‑GUI](https://github.com/iBridges-for-iRODS/iBridges-GUI) is a lightweight, cross‑platform graphical interface for **[iBridges](https://github.com/UtrechtUniversity/iBridges)**.  
It provides an intuitive way to work with **iRODS** on *Windows, Linux, and macOS*, without needing to use the command line.

The application is fully client‑side and agnostic to server rules or policies.

---

## Feature overview

<div style="
  background-color:#e6f7f3;
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:1.2rem 1.4rem;
  margin-bottom:1.5rem;
">

**iBridges‑GUI helps you:**

- Browse iRODS collections and inspect data  
- Upload, download, and synchronise files  
- Edit and view metadata  
- Search across collections and data objects  
- Review client and server configuration details  

</div>

---

## Supported iRODS versions

- 4.3.x and newer

---

## Requirements

- Python ≥ 3.9  
- PySide6  
- iBridges ≥ 2.1.x  

---

## Installation

### Stable release

```bash
pip install ibridges
pip install git+https://github.com/iBridges-for-iRODS/iBridges-GUI.git@main
```

### Development version

```bash
pip install ibridges
pip install git+https://github.com/iBridges-for-iRODS/iBridges-GUI.git@develop
```

Start the application

```bash
ibridges gui
```
